purpose: Prepare the exact controlled production path without applying production migrations, starting production backfill, switching runtime routing, or reclaiming V1 storage.

preflight_gates.pass_condition: latest PostgreSQL dump and V2 archive root are copied to an independent disk or volume, SHA-256 verified after copy, and the restore drill consumes that copied dump
evidence_required: copied archive root path if V2 archives already exist
restore evidence JSON proving the external copy was used

preflight_gates.pass_condition: database volume has at least 2.2x current database bytes free, archive volume has at least projected V2 archive bytes plus 30 percent free, and backup volume has at least one full dump plus archive copy free
WAL directory and archive policy can absorb the largest planned chunk burst with 2x safety margin; chunk size must be reduced if this cannot be proven
runtime account can create, atomically rename, read and delete a probe file under the configured V2 archive root; probe file contains no event payload
migration owner can create required V2 objects; backfill worker and runtime roles have only planned privileges; runtime role is not superuser and cannot create/drop databases

operator_runbook.name: freeze_collection_window
operator_runbook.action: Disable scheduler, collection and continuous recovery for the maintenance window; confirm runtime server and port state separately.
operator_runbook.rollback: Re-enable the previous scheduler/collection settings only if no migration/backfill step has started.

operator_runbook.name: backup_and_external_copy
operator_runbook.action: Create or select the approved PostgreSQL dump, copy it and required archive material to an independent disk or volume, then verify SHA-256 on the copy.
operator_runbook.rollback: Do not proceed; keep existing production unchanged.

operator_runbook.name: isolated_restore_from_external_copy
operator_runbook.action: Restore the external copy into a disposable database and run schema/count/last-event/API-or-query smoke checks.
operator_runbook.rollback: Drop only the disposable database and stop.

operator_runbook.name: production_preflight_dry_run
operator_runbook.action: Measure free space, WAL headroom, archive ACLs and role privileges without applying migrations or writing event rows.
operator_runbook.rollback: Stop; no production schema or data was changed.

operator_runbook.name: apply_migrations_9_10
operator_runbook.action: Only after all gates pass, apply V2 foundation and backfill-support migrations in a named maintenance window.
operator_runbook.rollback: Use versioned rollback SQL before any V2 read/write cutover; do not drop V1.

operator_runbook.name: controlled_full_backfill
operator_runbook.action: Run restartable production backfill with bounded chunks, WAL monitoring, archive hash verification and checkpoints.
operator_runbook.rollback: Stop workers, keep V1 primary, clean only incomplete V2 chunks through guarded rollback tooling.

operator_runbook.name: functional_shadow
operator_runbook.action: Run V1/V2 shadow checks for fast search, deep search, details, reports, findings and investigation surfaces.
operator_runbook.rollback: Keep read mode on V1 and fix adapters; do not reclaim.

operator_runbook.name: read_write_cutover
operator_runbook.action: Enable V2 read/write only after shadow acceptance and a rollback window are explicitly approved.
operator_runbook.rollback: Return read/write flags to V1 while V1 relations remain intact.

operator_runbook.name: external_fk_cutover
operator_runbook.action: Apply migration 12 only after V2 primary stability and validate external references.
operator_runbook.rollback: Use migration 12 rollback before any V1 decommission.

operator_runbook.name: dr_reclaim_gate
operator_runbook.action: Run a separate DR/reclaim acceptance package before dropping legacy events, event_entity_links or observed_entities.
operator_runbook.rollback: After physical drop, SQL rollback alone is impossible; recovery requires the independently verified backup/archive.

no_go_if: external copy missing or SHA mismatch
production schema is not version 8 before migration
runtime role has elevated admin privileges
operator cannot pause or resume workers

go_requires: functional shadow mismatches equal 0 or are explicitly waived
archive coverage and hash verification accepted
no_go_if: deep search or reports require unbounded archive scans
hydrated event details fail identity verification

go_requires: migration 12 accepted and rollback window decision recorded
fresh independent backup and restore proof
no_go_if: external backup restore was not tested
business owner has not accepted irreversible reclaim

strictly_forbidden: apply migrations 9 through 12 to production in this stage
start production backfill in this stage
enable V2 read/write routing in this stage
delete, truncate, rewrite or VACUUM FULL legacy V1 relations in this stage
treat accepted_with_warning final canary as rollback-proof acceptance
rerun expensive restored-copy canary without a new engineering question
